title: vandellia scapigera
intro: Vandellia scapigera, commonly known as "Tawas" in some regions, is a plant species that belongs to the family Scrophulariaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, diarrhea, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Vandellia scapigera include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal effects and potential health benefits.
